enrolmentVerification.sourceTitle: Fall 2025 full-time and part-time fall enrolment at Canadian universities
enrolmentVerification.retrievalMethod: Primary page read through web tool; direct command-line request returned HTTP403 and was not bypassed.

methods.periods: Original fiscal strings retained; normalized display periods do not change duration.
methods.projections: Original age/credential or age/NOC cell literals, preserving nearest-five/whole-number rounding.
methods.disease: Direct original Northern HA fiscal rows, with exact sex/indicator/source/unit checks; no rate recomputation.
methods.enrolment: Original institution totals reconciled to seven primary Fall 2025 category sums; Lakehead composite separated using independently published institution-only record.

limits: Provincial projections cannot be allocated to UNBC, northern communities or health areas.
Northern HA rates cannot be allocated to CHSAs; the locations inventory is metadata only.
Institutional totals cannot establish compatible campus/city populations; ratios stay held.
Existing unrelated C016/C049 funding, cancer, event and directory releases are not replaced.
